summary: Cadeler plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a stock exchange announcement that it will publish its Q3 2026 earnings release, covering results for the first nine months of 2026, at approximately 08:00 CET on 23 November 2026. A live video webcast will follow the same day, presented from London by CEO Mikkel Gleerup and CFO Peter Brogaard Hansen at 08:00 EST / 13:00 UK / 14:00 CET, with analysts able to ask questions live. The release and slides will be posted to the investor relations website, and an archived replay will remain available for at least three months. This is a routine earnings-notice filing, not a special situation; no transaction terms, board recommendation, or advisor are stated. No deal mechanics or risk-arb angle apply.
